items.title: Early prediction of prolonged ICU stay in sepsis patients using an explainable hybrid deep learning model
items.excerpt: An explainable hybrid deep learning model predicts which sepsis patients will have prolonged ICU stays earlier than existing clinical severity scores, aimed at critical-care resource planning.

items.title: Inferring clinically relevant molecular subtypes of pancreatic cancer from routine histopathology using deep learning
items.excerpt: Deep learning infers pancreatic cancer molecular subtypes, normally requiring costly gene-expression testing, directly from routine H&E histopathology slides.

items.title: Availability of performance evidence of approved AI diagnostic software in pathology and hematology morphology
items.excerpt: A systematic landscape analysis of regulator-authorized AI/ML in vitro diagnostic software for digital pathology and hematology morphology finds publicly available performance evidence is often missing.

items.title: Chatbot Intervention and Cancer Risk Knowledge in Adolescents and Young Adults With Cancer Predisposition
items.excerpt: A randomized clinical trial tested an electronic chatbot-based cancer risk communication tool for adolescents and young adults with hereditary cancer predisposition syndromes.

items.title: A Precedent for Regulating Clinical AI Models
items.excerpt: Former FDA commissioner Scott Gottlieb argues clinical AI models already in use could be regulated by improving on the pathway used for laboratory developed tests.

items.title: Governance and Responsible Deployment of AI-Enabled Pediatric Care
items.excerpt: A Viewpoint weighs benefits and risks of AI in pediatric settings and calls for dedicated governance structures for deploying it in children's care.

items.title: Radiology AI authorizations rise 42% as regulatory landscape evolves
items.excerpt: A new analysis of the FDA AI-enabled medical device database details how radiology AI authorizations rose 42% and how the regulatory standing of the technology has shifted.

items.title: Physicians fire back against HHS secretary’s claim AI is ‘better informed’ than human docs
items.excerpt: Physicians push back after HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. said AI is better informed than human doctors and could "free us from medical tyranny."

items.title: RSNA's AI certificate program undergoes 'major update'
items.excerpt: RSNA overhauled its on-demand AI certificate program, giving radiologists hands-on training in using AI in real-world clinical practice.

items.title: Riverain's ClearRead Chest AI comes to RapidAI platform
items.excerpt: Riverain's ClearRead chest X-ray/CT AI now integrates with RapidAI's Rapid Edge Cloud infrastructure and Rapid Navigator Pro radiology workflow software.

items.title: CARPL.ai, HOPPR partner on AI foundation models
items.excerpt: CARPL.ai is making HOPPR's medical imaging foundation models available on its radiology AI deployment platform.

items.title: HHS announces new efforts to speed up, expand clinical trials with AI
items.excerpt: HHS and ARPA-H announced new AI-driven efforts to speed up and expand clinical trials as federal officials seek to compete with countries like China.

items.title: Anthropic joins ARPA-H clinical AI moonshot, will hold closed-door health care event
items.excerpt: Anthropic joins an ARPA-H clinical AI effort and plans a closed-door health care event (STAT Health Tech newsletter edition).

items.title: Opinion: I’m a doctor. Here’s what I want the public to know about AI tools and health care costs
items.excerpt: A physician writes that AI documentation tools can inflate hospital bills even when clinicians document honestly, responding to BCBS research on AI and costs.

items.title: Insurers say AI could add billions in health costs. Billing companies disagree
items.excerpt: Insurer studies say AI-backed billing and coding tools used by providers raise health costs; the tool makers say the problem is the billing system, not AI.

items.title: Data privacy concerns could hold patients back from using AI
items.excerpt: A new survey finds patients increasingly concerned about their health data, which could slow adoption of AI in their care.

items.title: Weekly Rundown: Nextech taps Assort Health, EliseAI for agentic AI; Elsevier rolls out clinical AI tool for nurses
items.excerpt: Week of Oct. 5-9 health AI roundup: HHS awards $15M to AI projects, Nextech adds agentic AI for ophthalmology practices, Elsevier launches a clinical AI tool for nurses.

items.title: AI Can Flag Cognitive Decline Earlier — Health Systems Still Own What Happens Next
items.excerpt: AI flags of cognitive decline in the EHR create a clinical duty; health systems must decide in advance how a risk signal becomes an accountable care pathway.

items.title: 온코소프트, ASTRO 2026에서 AI 기반 방사선치료의 다음 단계 제시
items.excerpt: 온코소프트가 미국방사선종양학회 ASTRO 2026에서 'Agentic AI in Radiotherapy'를 주제로 차세대 AI 방사선치료 솔루션을 선보였다(8일 발표, 본문 날짜 기준).

items.title: 심평원 AI 심사 강화에…'사전점검 솔루션' 주목
items.excerpt: 심평원이 9월부터 무릎관절 AI 영상판독 결과를 실제 진료비 심사에 반영하는 등 심사를 AI 중심으로 재편하면서, 의료기관용 청구 사전점검 솔루션 고도화가 이어지고 있다.
